judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner computes (await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...)), requiring the caller to be BOTH admin AND owner rather than either, so plain team admins are denied. A team admin who is not the team owner attempts to add guests to a team booking they do not organize and receives FORBIDDEN despite being an admin — the authorization gate silently rejects a class of users the UI's add_members menu item is shown to.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and the team owner. This will incorrectly deny access to team admins who are not owners, and because the authorization gate is `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`, those admins will be blocked from adding guests. This is directly verifiable from the diff; the expected logic for an "admin or owner" check would be `||`.
